source.notes: Item description: 'Has no audio'. The AAC track is near-silent hiss (mean -72 dB, max -48 dB): mute it on ingest. The first ~15 s is a 'printed from preservation material in the National Film Archive, National Library of Australia' card: optional trim. Slow transfer speed, which accounts for the long runtime.
